name: reManager
blurb: A multi-platform desktop app for managing mods on reMarkable tablets.
description:
A multi-platform desktop app for managing mods on reMarkable tablets.
Powered by the Vellum package manager.

Features:

• Multi-Device Management: Save multiple sets of SSH credentials with password or key-based authentication

• Package Management: Browse, install, upgrade, and uninstall packages with automatic dependency resolution

• Maintenance Tools: Enable/disable auto-updates, set timezone, run package-provided scripts

• Interactive Terminal: Access a complete shell session on your reMarkable

• File Browser: Browse filesystem, transfer files to and from your reMarkable

• Backup and Restore: Backup and restore document library and configuration

• Configuration Editor: Edit system configuration files with syntax highlighting

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
